name: Archangel Ariel
source:
An angel of the eighth circle (Archangel) with even more combat experience and ability than Valkyrie, tasked with exacting the Goddess’s punishment. Though she rarely goes down to the surface world, she always keeps herself at the ready to descend into a big fight as the primary force. She participated in both the Great Monster Wars of 1,000 years ago, and the “Angel Massacre” incident of 500 years ago.

Her high combat capability has led her to exterminate thousands of high-ranking monsters on the surface world. In addition, she has given the merciless punishment of the Heavens to many human sinners who have traveled down the wrong path.

It should be noted that in the circles above Archangel, the duties of angels start to orient more towards duties of the soul and management of the Heavens. It isn’t implied that the combat capabilities of higher circle angels are higher than the Archangel class. Archangels, with their special forces use for battle, are more often than not just as powerful in combat as higher ranking angels.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
